_comment: The ONE place that says which upstream PoB pob-rust targets (R-UP). Read by tools/upstream.ts (probes), tools/sync-data.ps1, tools/upstream-mirror.ps1 and pob-golden (Rust tests). Env vars POB_ROOT / POB_GOLDENS_DIR (and, for the data converter, POB_TS_ROOT / POB_WASM_ROOT) override. pobTsRoot / wasmMirror: only tools/sync-data.ps1 and tools/upstream-mirror.ps1 (the pob-ts data converter) read them. Paths: absolute, or relative to the repo root.
